title: District Council Advice on Consumer Rights

content.scenario: A consumer in Mumbai approaches the District Council seeking advice on how to file a complaint against a defective product. The consumer is unsure about the procedure and needs guidance on their rights.
content.outcome: The District Council must render advice to the consumer on the promotion and protection of their rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, within the district of Mumbai.

user_queries: What is the role of the District Council in consumer protection?
How can I get advice on my consumer rights?
What are my rights as a consumer in Mumbai?
